trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the last trophy you earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done, so there is nothing extra to do for it beyond finishing the list. Treat it as the finish line for the roadmap, not a task of its own.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and it pops at the end of the mission. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic: complete Chapter 1 and the trophy pops as the story moves on. Keep playing the main missions and it comes on its own.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic: complete Chapter 2. No side requirement; the chapter's final mission is the trigger.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic: complete Chapter 3. Play the main missions in order and the trophy pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic: complete Chapter 4. Nothing optional is needed for it; finishing the chapter's missions is enough.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic: complete the final mission of the story. This is the last story trophy; after it, free-roam opens and the 100% completion checklist becomes visible.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic: complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Play the main missions in order and it pops.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic: complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks through normal story progress, so just keep playing.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic: complete the mission Child's Play. No preparation needed; the mission itself is the whole requirement.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic: complete the mission Headliners. Follow the story missions and it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic: complete the VCIA Takedown mission. It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed as long as you finish the story.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic: complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Play through the story and it pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set: open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion after the story and clear the checklist. The targets are lenient, about 60% true completion, with 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied, plus every robbery, race, range and discovery on the list. Progress made during the story already counts.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts across Stunt Jumps, Under the Bridges, Knife Flights and Base Jumps; the 100% checklist later asks for 300 of 397, so keep going past the trophy. Pick the categories you find easiest rather than clearing one type.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type once: races, fishing, the arcade, the shooting range, bowling, the gym and the rest. One attempt each is enough, no wins needed, so run through the list early while you are exploring.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 12 shooting ranges, 42 golds in total. Learn each range's scoring first, then chase golds one range at a time; the ranges also count toward the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every drone-race location. Learn each course's line before racing for the win, and note the locations count toward the checklist as well.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Variety is what counts, so enter new race types and locations instead of replaying one you already won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish the challenge when it is offered, match the right bait and spot, and keep your line steady through the fight.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Walk into an arcade, pick a cabinet, and play it through to the end. No high score is needed.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's strand. Andy's quests are Lucia-only, so switch to Lucia when his missions appear and follow the strand to its end.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's strand. Follow Kenton's missions as they appear across the map and finish the chain.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's strand. Keep answering Billy's calls and finish his missions in order.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only some strangers count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do, while Andy, Billy, Tyrone and Moses do not, so count strands on the trophy tracker, not every contact you meet.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's strand. Follow Randy's missions as they appear and finish the chain to its end.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's strand. Tyrone's missions are Jason-only, so play them as Jason and follow the strand through.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, with both Jason and Lucia. The one to protect is the first: after the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony when she mentions meditating and accept, because that spot is offered once in Chapter 1 and never comes back. The last spots only open once you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are Jason-only; track the animal he names, study it through the binoculars first, then take the shot.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida and the 100% checklist wants 15 sets in total, so keep a checklist of the sets you finish and pick up cards whenever you pass them.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Scan the environment as you travel, since the checklist also wants 100 WAiNK locations, and keep a separate note of where you have scanned so you do not repeat spots.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist asks for 70, so you can skip the hardest 10; work through the challenge groups you are best at first.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Bank vault jobs naturally bring 4 stars, so pair this with Maximum Withdrawal: get the crew out of the flashing search area and then out of the red heat zone entirely. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County gives cover from helicopters.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Keep the red-and-blue pursuit flashing between shops, because dropping the wanted level breaks the chain, and expect the trophy to pop about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning vehicles counts toward the 100% checklist too, which wants 200 of 277 base models, so scan every new vehicle you see while driving around.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Aim a firearm, press L3 and R3 together to trigger Combat Focus, and use an assault rifle on a clustered group of gang enemies; Adrenaline stretches the focus bar so you can chain the kills.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Take a large passenger plane that is connected to a boarding bridge, the one at terminals E3 and E4 works, climb to the cockpit, reverse toward the runway and take off, then fly about a kilometre from the airport for the delayed pop.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get behind the wheel of a Rhino tank and put it to use. Tanks turn up at military spots and during high wanted levels; once you are driving one, the trophy is about using it, so cause some chaos with it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs first to unlock the Snap Gun, then use it on the store's locked back door, find the safe-code note inside and open the safe quietly. Kicking the door sets off the alarm. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, out of 8 in total. Vault jobs open through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is: follow the security van to a bank and slip in while the guard has the vault open. Bring your partner, because you cannot carry all the cash bags alone, and have a fast bike ready, since every vault job brings 4 stars.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Hit a truck on the road, grab the cash, and clear both the flashing search area and the red heat zone before the trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Drive, fly and walk into every region of the map; the trophy tracks map coverage, so sweep the edges and the islands, not just Vice City.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this trophy is the first part of a much longer job: mark each gang off as you clear its first operation.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. A quiet trophy that costs nothing but a drink.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom glass and out the other side: pick a showroom, build speed, and go straight through.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt and Associates' bowling alley. At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, steal the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table, and the contents of the safe in the northeast hallway office. Bring Sticky Bombs for the safe, then escape the police; valuables you already collected still count if you come back.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia. Train at fitness clubs together so the inactive partner works out alongside the character you control, and keep at it until both bars are full.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that affect your Criminal Profile. Robberies and enemy encounters feed it naturally, so leave this one alone until the end of the run and check the profile counter before grinding the remainder.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This one pops on a repeat attempt at something that failed the first time, so when a job or encounter goes wrong, try it again instead of reloading an old save.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A secret-encounter trophy: keep an eye out for strange sights while exploring Leonida's quieter corners, especially at night, and investigate anything out of the ordinary.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. While driving past a group on foot, strike with a melee weapon from the vehicle: line the pass up on a straight road and swing as you go by.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; pass them to your contacts to wash them, and the total builds up across the whole run.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, hair, tattoos, food and gear all count, so this finishes naturally. Just do not save it all for the end; spend as you go.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Only the eight purchasable garages count; the four story garages do not need buying. They cost $160,000 in total, so reserve that money before spending freely, and buy them through the Vice City Real Estate phone app after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app unlocks through the Chapter 2 mission Moses: take eligible stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. Cheap cars and bikes keep the cost down; early on Moses only takes vehicles without trackers, and later Chapter 3 progress opens Standard Tracker vehicles and Pay 'n' Spray registration.
